leaderboard.summary: A friendly contest of token-burn. Opt in below to put your numbers on the board — only aggregates leave your machine, never conversation content.
leaderboard.previewText: The leaderboard table below is mock data. Real ranking opens when the backend is live. For now you can preview where you'd sit and copy your upload payload.
leaderboard.mockNote: mock rows — your row is real
leaderboard.optInBody: Joining is off by default. Toggle on and pick a nickname to make your row eligible once the backend ships. Your local dashboard is unaffected either way.
leaderboard.payloadHint: This is exactly what would be POSTed to the leaderboard backend. Aggregates only — no titles, no transcripts, no project names.
leaderboard.privacy1: Conversation content (titles, transcripts, code, project names) never leaves your machine.
leaderboard.privacy2: Only aggregates are uploaded: monthly cost, total tokens, session count, cache hit rate, vendor mix, client mix.
leaderboard.privacy3: Opt in is off by default. You can leave the leaderboard at any time by deleting your row.
leaderboard.privacy4: No verification — numbers are self-reported. Treat the ranking as a vibes contest, not a leaderboard of truth.
